title: Low Pressure Fuel System Pressure Too Low
shortDescription: Lift / low-pressure side fuel pressure below threshold.
fullDescription:
P008A sets when the low-pressure (lift pump) side of a high-pressure direct-injection or diesel fuel system falls below the calibrated threshold for too long. The high-pressure pump cannot maintain rail pressure without adequate supply.

Common causes include a failing lift pump, plugged filter, or restricted lines. Continued operation can damage the high-pressure pump.
safetyImpact: Possible engine stall; pull over if power loss is severe.

fixSteps.title: Check filter and supply pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Use a gauge at the test port.

fixSteps.title: Inspect lift pump operation
fixSteps.instruction: Listen for prime cycle and measure current.

faq.a: Loss of power can be sudden - repair promptly.
Most low-pressure system codes appear on diesels and GDI vehicles.

title: Low Pressure Fuel System Pressure Too High
shortDescription: Lift / low-pressure side fuel pressure above threshold.
fullDescription:
P008B indicates the low-pressure side fuel pressure exceeds calibrated maximum. Causes include a stuck regulator, restricted return line, or a faulty pressure sensor.

Excessive lift pressure stresses lines and can cause leaks; address promptly.
safetyImpact: Possible engine stall; pull over if power loss is severe.

fixSteps.title: Check filter and supply pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Use a gauge at the test port.

fixSteps.title: Inspect lift pump operation
fixSteps.instruction: Listen for prime cycle and measure current.

faq.a: Loss of power can be sudden - repair promptly.
Most low-pressure system codes appear on diesels and GDI vehicles.

title: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit / Open (Bank 2)
shortDescription: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit / Open (Bank 2) on the secondary fuel pump circuit.
fullDescription:
This code addresses the secondary or auxiliary fuel pump used on flex-fuel, dual-tank, or high-output platforms. Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit / Open (Bank 2) indicates an electrical or performance fault that prevents proper pump operation.

Loss of secondary pump function may cause loss of power, fuel starvation under load, or stalling at high demand.

fixSteps.title: Inspect relay/driver
fixSteps.instruction: Verify control signal at PCM command.

faq.a: Yes - some platforms use a primary and secondary pump.
Secondary pump replacement can be lower if it is in-tank only.

title: Fuel Pump Module Control Circuit B
shortDescription: Auxiliary fuel pump module B control circuit fault.
fullDescription:
P00C6 sets when the PCM cannot drive the auxiliary fuel pump module (FPM) B. The FPM is a smart driver mounted near the fuel tank that varies pump speed based on PCM command.

Without module B, fuel volume to the high-pressure pump may be inadequate at high load.

fixSteps.title: Replace FPM
fixSteps.instruction: Install new module and program if needed.

faq.a: On some vehicles yes, but programming may be required.
Module A is primary; B is auxiliary or rear tank.

title: Fuel Injector Lift Switch / Sensor Circuit Low
shortDescription: Injector lift sensor circuit reports circuit low.
fullDescription:
Some diesel and high-end gasoline injectors use a lift sensor (needle position sensor) to confirm injector opening. Circuit Low indicates the PCM cannot validate injector operation via the lift signal.

Without this feedback the PCM may default to open-loop injection timing, hurting emissions and economy.

faq.a: Mostly diesel and some unit-injector gasoline systems.
Replace only the affected injector.

title: Injection Pump Fuel Metering Control A Malfunction
shortDescription: Injection pump A metering control reports malfunction.
fullDescription:
This code is set on diesel and direct-injection systems that use an electronic fuel metering control. Malfunction indicates the PCM cannot regulate injected fuel quantity through pump A within calibrated limits.

Metering control faults usually require pump diagnostics or replacement at a specialty shop.

faq.a: Generally no - requires specialty equipment.
Diesels with electronic distributor pumps and some early CRD systems.

title: Secondary Air Injection System Malfunction
shortDescription: Secondary air injection system reports system malfunction.
fullDescription:
The secondary air injection (SAI) system pumps fresh air into the exhaust during cold start to accelerate catalyst light-off and reduce hydrocarbon emissions. System Malfunction indicates the PCM cannot verify proper SAI operation.

Most SAI faults are emissions-related and do not affect normal driveability outside cold-start.

fixSteps.title: Listen for pump on cold start
fixSteps.instruction: Pump should run 30-90 seconds after start.

fixSteps.title: Inspect check valve
fixSteps.instruction: Should pass air to exhaust only.

faq.q: Why does my car only fail emissions?
faq.a: SAI is only active briefly on cold start.
Not legally on emissions-equipped vehicles.
